title: Flow

trigger.description: What starts it, and which actor: "The user runs /feynman-extract in Pi".

outcome.description: What is true or produced when it completes.

items.description: One semantic action in a flow, performed by `actor`, optionally directed at `target`.

component.description: The component in the actor that does the work.

ref.description: A sub-flow this step delegates to.

protocol.description: The protocol this step speaks or parses.

properties.description: Guarantees and conditions: transactional, idempotent, retried, bounded, under a lock, etc.

description: A behaviour of the system: something it does for an actor, from a trigger to an outcome (build a model, render it, accept an upload). Not how the system is built, installed, or developed.
